'''Hurwell''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] in the [[Republic Army|army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the war he was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], where a [[Separatist War|civil war]] had broken out between the Republic backed [[Ord Mantell Central Authority]] and the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]]. Hurwell was posted on the outskirts of the Republic held [[Fort Garnik]] on [[Avilatan]] island, where he operated a stall from which he sold various specialty goods. While at his stall Hurwell wore [[Color/Legends|white]] and blue [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. He had fair skin, red hair and blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hurwell first appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]]. In the game Hurwell acts as a specialist goods vendor on Ord Mantell.<ref name="TOR" /> He was removed from the game in update 6.2 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]''.<ref name="Patch notes 6.2">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/1292020/game-update-6.2|text=Game Update 6.2}}</ref> He was later brought back to the game in update 7.1 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''.<ref name="Patch notes 7.1">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/08022022/game-update-7.1-digging-deeper|text=Game Update 7.1: Digging Deeper Patch Notes}}</ref>
